rewards_accrual_enabled.meaning: the target GTELaunchpadV2Pair has rewards accrual enabled

accrued_launchpad_fees_present.meaning: the pair holds accrued launchpad fees (accruedLaunchpadFee0/accruedLaunchpadFee1) that attackers can generate themselves

no_token_transfers_in_call.meaning: no token transfers into the pair occur during the call

caller_has_no_special_permissions.meaning: the caller is any external user without special permissions, needing only gas to call mint(), swap(), or burn()

locked_assets_stolen.meaning: the caller obtains locked token0 and token1 assets from the pair beyond what they actually transferred in

claims.scope: GTELaunchpadV2Pair mint/swap/burn accounting of accrued launchpad fees

preconditions.text: The target GTELaunchpadV2Pair has rewards accrual enabled.; The pair has accrued some launchpad fees (accruedLaunchpadFee0 and accruedLaunchpadFee1), which attackers can generate themselves.; No token transfers into the pair occur in the call.; The attack can be executed by any external user without special permissions, requiring only gas fees to call mint(), swap(), or burn().
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Accrued launchpad fees held in the pair must not be counted as user-supplied amounts, so mint(), swap(), and burn() must not let a caller obtain tokens or liquidity beyond what they actually transferred in.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Attackers can steal locked assets (both token0 and token1) from any GTELaunchpadV2Pair with rewards accrual enabled.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: mint(), swap(), and burn() are treated as alternative call paths by which a caller may obtain tokens or liquidity; the report does not fix their order.
Accrued fees are assumed to be present in the pair's balances while excluded from _reserve0/_reserve1, per the root-cause statement.
The caller is an arbitrary external user; no privileged role is required.

limitations: The impact is formalized as a Boolean observable of obtaining locked assets beyond amounts transferred in; no numeric magnitude is bound because the report supplies none.
Other impacts (imp_affects_all_graduated_pairs, imp_repeated_until_drained, imp_drain_pool_financial_loss) are not covered by this plan and are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
The relation is stated at the report level; runtime binding to code is deferred.
